---
title: Built-in qmd / markdown highlighting
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      dom-parity: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # GH #1081. `qmd` and its `markdown` / `md` aliases resolve to the
        # built-in qmd composite: the structure maps onto styled `hl-*`
        # classes, the front matter is highlighted as YAML, and the nested
        # python cell is highlighted as Python with its `#|` option as YAML.
        - ["<pre class=\"sourceCode qmd\"", "<pre class=\"sourceCode markdown\"", "<pre class=\"sourceCode md\"", "hl-markup-bold\">bold</span>", "hl-markup-link\">link</span>", "hl-property\">title</span>", "hl-comment\">#\\|</span>", "hl-property\">echo</span>", "hl-function-builtin\">print</span>"]
---

`````qmd
---
title: "Report"
format: html
---

## Results

Some **bold** text and a [link](https://example.com).

```{python}
#| echo: false
print("hello")
```
`````

````markdown
## Results
````

```md
# md alias
```
